xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5209: pan close: merged check compares against a stale local main, so merged polyrepo issues can't close out

plan.title: pan close: merged check compares against a stale local main, so merged polyrepo issues can't close out
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Close-out's merged check (DoD row 4) compares each repo's feature branch with the bare local target branch. Primary checkouts never pull main, so MIN-1139/MIN-1140 fail with '10 unmerged commit(s)' (myn-skills) and '29 unmerged commit(s)' (openclaw-plugin) although both feature branches equal origin/main. Rows 1 and 2 also fail with 'no pull request found on the forge' because they read only a GitHub PR, and MYN is a Linear-tracked GitLab/polyrepo project.
narratives.Proposal: Extract the merge verifier from workflows.ts (at its file-size cap) into src/lib/lifecycle/verify-merged.ts; resolve a comparison ref per repo by fetching origin/<target> (falling back to the local ref with a stated note) and use it at all eight comparison sites; give GitLab MRs the same post-merge-delta tolerance GitHub PRs have; and, for non-GitHub-tracked issues with no GitHub PR, let rows 1 and 2 record a skip (not a pass: no verdict is observed) on read-only repo landing evidence (forge asked first for a merged PR/MR in every required repo; repos without one must have no branch work), read once per gate evaluation. Document it in docs/MERGE-WORKFLOW.md and changelog.d/pan-5209.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing src/lib/close-out.ts isBranchMerged (closed-issue reaper) — it also compares with local main, but changing it alters what the reaper deletes
- Changing resolveRepositoryDefaultBranch in src/lib/pipeline-membership-gather.ts (pipeline membership and row 4's containment fallback)
- Reading GitLab MR approvals or pipeline status for rows 1 and 2
- Recording review verdicts in polyrepo GitLab workspaces (PAN-5097)
- Any change to rows 3, 5, 6, 7 or 8
- Pulling, resetting or checking out local main in primary checkouts
- Changing GitHub-tracked issues' row 1/2 behavior
- Raising any file-size allowlist cap
- Changing assessMergeCompleteness or the merge flow's Single Merge Oracle

autoDecisions.summary: Cover the rows 1/2 GitLab gap in this issue rather than naming another owner
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-5097 owns recording verdicts, not the DoD read; no other open issue owns it, and the issue's goal (MIN-1139/1140 close out) needs both fixes.

autoDecisions.summary: A failed fetch falls back to the local target ref even if a cached origin/<target> exists
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue states this fallback explicitly; the step details say so.

autoDecisions.summary: Rows 1 and 2 accept merged forge artifacts as landing evidence without reading GitLab approvals or pipelines
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for merged MRs as landing evidence; MR !121 showed approvals carry no signal (approved with zero approvers) and glab mr list has no pipeline field.

autoDecisions.summary: Rows 1/2 use a new read-only, forge-first repo landing evidence module instead of assessMergeCompleteness
autoDecisions.rationale: assessMergeCompleteness returns no-changes for zero-ahead repos before asking the forge; every MIN-1139/1140 repo is zero-ahead (merge-commit MRs), so it would find no positive evidence. It also upserts a merge-set row, and the DoD gate only reads.
Updates the remote-tracking ref even under a narrowed remote.origin.fetch and never touches local main.

autoDecisions.summary: Extract the verifier before changing it
autoDecisions.rationale: workflows.ts is 1153 lines against a 1160 cap; agents may not raise caps.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the existing unmerged-commit message text unchanged
autoDecisions.rationale: Minimizes test churn; the fallback note covers the one case where the compared ref is not origin/<target>.

autoDecisions.summary: Rows 1/2 record skip, not pass, on complete forge merge evidence
autoDecisions.rationale: Plan critic round 1: no review decision or check result is observed, so pass would be false; skip matches terminalVerdictSettlement's outcome for an unknown verdict on landed work and still unblocks close-out as the issue requires.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. Add TargetComparison { ref; note? } and resolveTargetComparison(dir, targetBranch), which runs `git fetch origin +refs/heads/<t>:refs/remotes/origin/<t>` (cwd dir, encoding utf-8, timeout 30000) and returns origin/<t>; on failure, when `git rev-parse --verify --quiet refs/heads/<t>^{commit}` resolves, the bare <t> with note `Checked against local <t> because git fetch origin <t> failed: <reason>` (reason = first non-empty line of stderr, else message, max 200 chars); otherwise { ref: null, error: 'Cannot verify merge: git fetch origin <t> failed (<reason>) and no local <t> branch exists' }, and verifyConventionBranchMerged returns stepFailed with that error before any git comparison runs (the diff commands swallow errors, so an empty diff must never be reached without a ref). Add optional comparison to MergeVerificationRoot. Split verifyConventionBranchMerged into an internal verifyConventionBranchAgainst(ctx, root, comparison) plus the exported wrapper that resolves the comparison (unless root.comparison is set) and applies withComparisonNote: note appended to details on success/skip, appended to error as ` (<note>)` on failure. Replace root.targetBranch with comparison.ref at the is-ancestor, three-dot diff and git log commands in verifyConventionBranchAgainst and verifyRemoteBranchIfPresent, and set remoteTargetRef = comparison.ref in verifySquashMergedPrByBranch. Keep targetBranch: root.targetBranch (bare) in the findMergedArtifact call. verifyRootConventionBranches resolves once and passes the comparison to both the feature/ and strike/ calls. Rewrite the ~47 mocked command strings in workflows.test.ts from bare main/master to origin/main/origin/master in the same commit, and add the two fetch-failure cases from PRD WI-2 step 7. Detail strings such as 'All commits merged to main' stay byte-identical.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3. New test file that does NOT mock child_process or util. Real git under os.tmpdir(), removed in afterEach; every commit uses -c user.email=t@example.com -c user.name=T -c commit.gpgsign=false. Fixture (pin branch names so init.defaultBranch cannot change them): `git init --bare --initial-branch=main origin.git`; `git clone origin.git primary` then `git checkout -B main` in primary; c1 on main pushed; clone other; c2, c3 on main pushed; `git push origin main:feature/pan-900`; in primary `git fetch origin feature/pan-900:feature/pan-900` so local main stays at c1. Call verifyConventionBranchMerged({ issueId: 'PAN-900', projectPath: primary }, { repoKey: 'myn-skills', dir: primary, sourceBranch: 'feature/pan-900', targetBranch: 'main', forge: 'github' }). Cases: (1) passes with details ['All commits merged to main', 'Remote branch fully merged'] and `git rev-parse main` in primary still equals c1; (2) with an extra unpushed commit c4 on feature/pan-900 it fails with error '1 unmerged commit(s) on feature/pan-900. Merge before closing out.'; (3) after `git remote set-url origin <tmp>/missing.git` it fails with error matching /\(Checked against local main because git fetch origin main failed: .+\)$/. (4) In a clone where local main is deleted (`git checkout --detach && git branch -D main`) and origin points at a missing path, it fails with error matching /^Cannot verify merge: git fetch origin main failed \(.+\) and no local main branch exists$/.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4. In src/lib/forge.ts add optional headSha?: string to CreateReviewArtifactResult and return headSha: merged.sha from findMergedGitLabArtifact (GitHub adapter unchanged). In verify-merged.ts extract the post-merge delta block of verifySquashMergedPrByBranch into judgePostMergeDelta({ root, branchRef, mergedHead, tipSha, targetRef, label, kind: 'PR'|'MR', fallbackLabel }) so GitHub strings stay byte-identical and GitLab gets post-MR wording. verifySquashMergedMrByBranch looks the MR up without headSha (bare targetBranch), caches the artifact once per lookup, returns today's success when tip == artifact.headSha, calls judgePostMergeDelta with targetRef = comparison.ref when they differ, and returns null when headSha is missing. In verifyConventionBranchAgainst, only a successful GitLab result takes the early pass; after the diff-empty fallback add `if (gitlabMerged && !gitlabMerged.result.success) return gitlabMerged.result;`. Rewrite the 'falls through when a merged GitLab MR head does not match the branch tip' test and add the two acceptance tests named in PRD WI-4 step 5; the 'reuses one GitLab MR lookup' test must still see exactly one glab mr list call. Test-mock note: the default mock answers unknown commands with '' and [].every() is true, so every GitLab mismatch case must mock both `git diff --name-only merged-head..newer-tip` and `git diff --name-only origin/main...newer-tip` (copy the GitHub tests near workflows.test.ts lines 1060-1090); the .pan-only case must make `git merge-base --is-ancestor post-commit origin/main` throw so it does not pass at the containment step. In the shared helper's three-dot fallback change `statePlaneOnly = deltaFiles.every(...)` to `statePlaneOnly = deltaFiles.length > 0 && deltaFiles.every(...)` (both forges; GitHub strings unchanged). Add the test 'rejects a merged GitLab MR when post-MR commits leave an empty delta' (both name-only diffs return '' -> failure 'feature/pan-100 has 1 commit(s) after merged MR !75 that are not on origin/main: post-commit').

metadata.acJustification: Five ACs: one per landing state plus the verdict/memo pair; the remaining verdict rules are pinned by exact texts in the narrative and PRD.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5 (and FR-6..FR-10). New src/lib/lifecycle/dod-forge-merge.ts (<=200 lines, read-only, writes nothing) exporting RepoLanding/RepoLandingEvidence/ForgeMergeVerdict types, assessRepoLanding(repo), readRepoLandingEvidence(issueId), readForgeMergeVerdict(read) and memoizeOnce(read). Do NOT reuse assessMergeCompleteness: it returns no-changes for zero-ahead repos before asking the forge, and every MIN-1139/1140 repo is zero-ahead. assessRepoLanding per required repo: (1) getForgeAdapter(repo.forge).findMergedArtifact({ sourceBranch, targetBranch (bare), cwd: repoPath }) - throw -> unverifiable '<repoKey>: merged-artifact lookup failed: <message>', artifact -> merged (url); (2) resolveTargetComparison(repoPath, targetBranch) from ./verify-merged.js - a result with a note (local fallback) or ref null -> unverifiable '<repoKey>: git read failed: <note or error>'; then `git ls-remote --heads origin <source>` (non-zero exit -> unverifiable); non-empty output -> `git fetch origin +refs/heads/<source>:refs/remotes/origin/<source>` (failure -> unverifiable) and tip = origin/<source>; empty output -> tip = refs/heads/<source> when `git rev-parse --verify --quiet refs/heads/<source>^{commit}` resolves, else no-branch-work '<repoKey>: no <source> branch'; never use a cached origin/<source> without a successful refresh; (3) `git merge-base --is-ancestor <tip> <ref>` fails -> unlanded '<repoKey>: <source> is not on <ref> and has no merged review artifact'; (4) tip in `git rev-list --first-parent <ref>` -> no-branch-work '<repoKey>: <source> points at <ref> history', else unlanded '<repoKey>: <source> work reached <ref> without a merged review artifact'; (5) any other git failure -> unverifiable '<repoKey>: git read failed: <message>'. Verdict rules in order: read throws -> unverifiable 'forge merge state read failed: <msg>'; any unverifiable -> unverifiable 'forge merge evidence unavailable: <reasons joined ; >'; no repos -> incomplete 'forge merge incomplete: no repositories resolved'; any unlanded -> incomplete 'forge merge incomplete: <unlanded reasons joined ; >'; no merged -> incomplete 'forge merge incomplete: no repository has a merged review artifact'; else complete 'forge merge complete: <list>' with '<repoKey> merged (<url>)' / '<repoKey> merged' / '<repoKey> no branch work' joined by ', '. Imports use bare 'child_process'/'util'. Tests in tests/unit/lib/lifecycle/dod-forge-merge.test.ts: stubbed verdict cases, memoizeOnce, and real-git assessRepoLanding cases with forge.js mocked (fixture branches pinned with --initial-branch=main). Also test (e): lookup null and origin pointing at a missing path -> unverifiable with reason starting 'fe: git read failed:', and a verdict case with api merged plus fe unverifiable -> kind unverifiable.
